narrative: The letter, open. A creased sheet held flat under your right hand, the ink on the forefinger at the margin. Beside the sheet, not yet wrapped, a cake of hard soap and a skein of Coventry blue thread. Candlelight. No second surface. The letter, open. Your thumb under that one phrase. The rest of the sheet asks for three small things and does not make the third plainer than this.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the letter through and stayed on the unmatched phrase.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the letter before Christmas. She is not in the room.
